name: @thetis/provider-openrouter
description: Sends model calls to OpenRouter with streaming, tool calls, and prompt caching.

thetis.label: OpenRouter models
thetis.summary: Adds the models available through OpenRouter.

apiKey.help: The OpenRouter API key, sent as the bearer token of every request; put it in .env as OPENROUTER_API_KEY and reference it.

baseUrl.help: The API root; a proxy or a compatible endpoint goes here.

headers.help: Extra HTTP headers sent with every request, over the HTTP-Referer and X-Title the provider sets.

defaults.help: Request fields sent with every call under call.params, for example max_tokens or provider.order.

cache.help: The prompt caching policy: enabled (true), ttl (5m), systemTtl (1h), anchorStride (8), maxBreakpoints (4), explicitVendors (["anthropic"]), overrides ({}), hints (tune) and affinity (true); see packages/prompt-cache/README.md.

retries.help: How many times a request that got no response, or a transient refusal (429, 408, 409, 425, 5xx, an in-flight budget 402) asking for a wait of 10 s or less, is quietly tried again before it is reported. Longer waits, and every retry after these, are the harness's, which shows them on the page. A failure after the reply has started is not tried again here: it is reported, labelled, and the harness sends the round again.

requestTimeoutMs.help: How long the whole attempt to get a response may take, retries and the waits between them included. Node's fetch has no timeout of its own, so without this a connection that opens and then says nothing waits for ever.

streamStallMs.help: How long an open stream may send no bytes at all before it is abandoned. Any byte resets it, so this is not a limit on how long a reply may take.
